properties.name: Észak-nyugati városrész
properties.sourcePeriod: Plan TT08518-M1/24, page 1 visibly printed issue date 2024. 11. (November 2024); Annex 1/B to 39/2021. (XII.28.) municipal ordinance. Current legal validity not independently certified.
properties.method: Exact centreline of original native blue vector source strokes. Only the original 1238 line segments are noded and polygonized into 4 source-defined closed faces; no invented closing chord. Actual blue map-label positions identify each source face. Frozen approximate page 1 actual-municipal-perimeter-to-OSM registration in EOV, linked to page 2 by 4888 actual source CAD segment pairs. Inverse projection to WGS84. No name-point coordinates, clipping, snapping, buffers or geometry repair.
reviewNotes: These are 4 whole irregular geographic planning units, not 4 plan-sheet rectangles. The blue legend explicitly says city-region boundary; the plan also depicts regulation territorial scope.
Keep the complete source label. Bánfalva/Kutyahegy is a grouped unit and southeast is an economic planning area. No group footprint is copied onto constituent names.
Page1 municipal source line samples and thousands of cross-page real CAD endpoint pairs establish calculation provenance, not independent absolute geographic accuracy.
Whole-perimeter matching residuals and cross-page residuals are diagnostics. No independently surveyed or identified interior world controls are claimed.

An extracted-only .../2024 CAD placeholder is not visibly printed in the original rendered white block; it does not establish visible draft or approval status. Current legal validity remains unverified.
Unknown source reuse rights, current legal validity and absolute accuracy; address assignment remains disabled.
properties.license: Municipal plan reuse rights not independently established; ODbL applies to OSM calibration reference.
